scripts.bootstrap: git submodule update --init vendor/syncthing/upstream && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run syncthing:build
scripts.build: bun run predev && bun run --filter @kitesync/web build && bun run --filter @kitesync/node-service build
scripts.check: bun run predev && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run boundaries:check && bun run terminology:check && bun run syncthing:verify && bun run migrations:check && bun run licenses:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.predev: bun run --filter @kitesync/contracts build && bun run --filter @kitesync/ui build && bun run --filter @kitesync/api-client build
scripts.docker:build: bun --no-env-file scripts/verify-syncthing-vendor.mjs && docker build -f deploy/docker/Dockerfile -t kitesync/node:local .
scripts.docker:up: bun --no-env-file scripts/verify-syncthing-vendor.mjs && docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run --filter @kitesync/node-service package
scripts.test:integration: bun --no-env-file run predev && bun --bun --no-env-file vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
